paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.69% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+3.13%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.38%). Brent crude changed +4.91% to 109.86. Gold changed -0.83% to 4,181.1001. Bitcoin changed -0.09% to 81,685.3516. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.098%, a relative move of -2.78%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+9.25%) and Equinor (+9.23%) moved the most.
